CustomField.label: Options JSON
CustomField.description: JSON array of exactly four options, [{"value":1,"label":"...","points":1}, ...], values 1-4 with no gaps or duplicates. "value" is the option's IDENTITY -- what a stored answer means -- and never changes. "points" is what that option is WORTH, set by the content author; omitted, it defaults to the value, which is what every option was worth before points were authorable. Points let an author make a scale non-linear (1/1/3/4) without making two prospects' totals incomparable: the build script requires min points 1, max points 4 and no descent, so every slot is still worth 1-4 and the frame is still out of 32. Null inherits the options from the next-least-specific pack, and ultimately from GTM_Assessment_Question__mdt. All four are declared even when Max_Attainable__c caps the slot, because the excluded option still has to render -- greyed, with the reason -- so a prospect can see a 4 was not on offer and why.
